comment: Three of the eleven parameters, the detune offset and the two detune rotation controls, have no widget on the panel and live only on the right-click menu. The feedback amount is not clamped: Pkm.cpp:138 maps the knob-plus-input total onto 0.1 to 1.0 without a limit, so a large negative voltage on the feedback jack drives it below 0.1. The panel prints the four algorithm choices as icons rather than words; the names Simple, Double, Entangled and Echo come from the maker's switch labels and the manual.
